The source decision concerns the type of HubSpot report, not synchronization of HubSpot lead lists to MeetAlfred.
The simple-sales-funnel reporting decision does not alter the MeetAlfred campaign creation or Zap provisioning workflow.
The source message specifies a HubSpot reporting format and does not resume or otherwise change the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation requirement.
